relevance_note: Case report of a proband and her mother carrying a GFAP variant: "The same heterozygous variant was detected in her mother."
method_note: Read the whole paper by hand; a Python script in the scratch directory only assembled the JSON and checked spans (no table transcription; the paper has no tables). Variant strings use thin spaces (U+2009) as printed. Labels III:1, II:3 and I:4 are the paper's pedigree labels. I:4 (grandmother) tested negative for the variant ('healthy grandmother'); she gets an individual row and an all-'not reported' checklist but no variant or feature rows. The aunt (informant only) and the father (no information) are not given rows. Proband onset recorded as 13 years from 'scoliosis, and episodes of enuresis since she was 13 years old' (ambiguous whether 'since 13' covers scoliosis). Mother: the paper does not say her parent was tested (the grandmother I:4 is not stated to be the mother's mother), so her inheritance and parental testing are 'not reported'; disease label 'not reported' because the authors only say she was 'misdiagnosed with PPMS'. Mother's age at last evaluation not recorded: the MRI at 41 and PEG at 40 are not stated to be the last evaluation. Proband: EEG discharges 'with no clinical correlations' and AED treatment do not state seizures, so seizures = not reported. 'no enhancement was identified in these areas' covers only the T2-hyperintense areas, so the checklist contrast-enhancement item stays not reported (narrower absence). Cervical cord atrophy for the proband uses the Figure 2 legend (panels 2c/3c are the daughter's per the legend) plus the text 'spinal cord atrophy'. Negative work-up for Wilson disease, acquired ataxias and SCA repeat expansions not recorded as features (investigations as a whole). In-silico scores (MetaLR, Revel) not recorded as functional evidence. No contradictions found.
